global_macro_regime.label: EQUITY_LIQUIDITY_SQUEEZE_FLIGHT_TO_TREASURIES
global_macro_regime.summary: Severe mega-cap tech and global equity de-grossing has triggered an authentic flight-to-safety into US Treasuries, pulling benchmark yields down sharply. Concurrently, acute margin and liquidity strains are forcing leveraged funds to dump crowded winners in precious metals and crypto to cover equity losses.
global_macro_regime.dominant_theme: Equity De-Risking Spurs Treasury Safe-Haven Bid While Forcing Metals & Crypto Liquidation

causal_chains.event: Tech Valuation De-Grossing and Equity Liquidity Wall
transmission_steps: Mega-cap tech valuation unwind triggers heavy equity liquidation and VIX spike.
Capital flees risky assets into US Treasuries, driving yields sharply down.
Equity indexes plunge while duration bonds rally on flight-to-safety flows.
causal_chains.tape_evidence: NQ 1D -4.62% and SPX 1D -3.01% while US 10Y yield drops 14bps to 4.912% and TLT rallies +1.37% 1D / +2.61% 5D.

causal_chains.event: Crowded Long Liquidation in Precious Metals via Cross-Asset Margin Pressure
transmission_steps: Multi-asset drawdown and VIX spike trigger cross-margin calls across leveraged funds.
Highly crowded long positions in gold are sold to raise cash collateral.
Gold and silver decline sharply despite dropping real yields and geopolitical strikes.
causal_chains.tape_evidence: COT Gold Managed Money long is 86.5%; XAUUSD drops -2.41% 1D / -8.93% 5D and XAGUSD drops -15.42% 5D despite TIPS yield dropping 14bps 5D to 2.77%.

causal_chains.event: US Treasury Yield Collapse Triggers Carry Trade Unwind in USDJPY
transmission_steps: Flight to Treasuries drives US 2Y down 25bps and 10Y down 23bps 5D.
US-Japan sovereign yield differentials compress rapidly, making JPY carry expensive.
Leveraged funds trim USD longs, forcing USDJPY lower alongside global risk-off.
causal_chains.tape_evidence: US 10Y yields fall 14bps 1D and 23bps 5D; USDJPY falls -0.72% 1D to 158.54.

causal_chains.event: Global Growth Slowdown & Risk Liquidation Truncates Energy Geopolitical Premium
transmission_steps: Tanker attacks near Hormuz provide transient supply concerns in oil markets.
Severe global equity slump and demand destruction fears overwhelm Middle East disruptions.
Crude oil rallies weakly intraday but remains deeply negative on multi-week horizon.
causal_chains.tape_evidence: USCRUDE trades up +0.42% 1D on tanker hits, but down -4.91% 5D and -18.86% 20D while Copper falls -9.78% 5D.

XAUUSD.dominant_mechanism: Equity drawdowns force margin calls -> 86.5% long COT liquidated -> Gold sells off
bullish_forces: 10Y TIPS real yield fell 14bps 5D to 2.77%
Tanker attacks in Hormuz stoke safe-haven demand
bearish_forces: Managed Money extreme long at 86.5% creates liquidation overhang
Cash liquidity squeeze forces sales to cover equity losses
XAUUSD.invalidation_trigger: 10Y real yields rebound above 2.90% while XAUUSD reclaims $3,650 on volume.

XAGUSD.dominant_mechanism: Industrial slowdown plus precious metals de-grossing accelerates silver liquidation cascade
bullish_forces: Drop in US yields reduces carrying cost of holding metals
Oversold bounce potential after severe -23.48% 20D decline
bearish_forces: Copper collapse (-9.78% 5D) signals severe industrial demand contraction
Silver dropped -15.42% 5D reflecting forced liquidation across leveraged accounts
XAGUSD.invalidation_trigger: Copper rebounds above $5.80 and XAGUSD crosses above $44.50.

EURUSD.dominant_mechanism: Falling US yields support EUR while European growth and cyber headwinds cap upside
bullish_forces: US 10Y yield fell 14bps intraday, eroding USD yield advantage
German Bund yields ticking higher relative to falling US Treasuries
bearish_forces: FDAX down -8.09% 5D reflects acute European growth headwinds
DXY remains up +2.00% 20D with EUR down -2.23% 20D
EURUSD.invalidation_trigger: EURUSD breaks above 1.1080 or US 10Y yield surges back above 5.05%.

GBPUSD.dominant_mechanism: Global equity selloff depresses high-beta sterling despite falling US Treasury yields
bullish_forces: US 2Y yield plunged 25bps 5D, softening broad dollar yields
CFTC Leveraged Funds hold net long GBP position (62.5% long)
bearish_forces: Global risk-off and VIX spike (26.8) punish cyclical growth currencies
GBP 5D return of -0.98% underperforms EUR and USD
GBPUSD.invalidation_trigger: Global equities stage 3%+ relief rally and GBPUSD clears 1.3200.

USDJPY.dominant_mechanism: Plunging US Treasury yields narrow US-JP yield spread, triggering carry unwinds
bullish_forces: Nikkei crash (-10.0% 5D) reflects domestic Japanese financial stress
CFTC positioning still shows Leveraged Funds long USDJPY (55.7%)
bearish_forces: US 10Y down 23bps 5D rapidly compresses US-JP bond spreads
USDJPY dropped -0.72% 1D as safe-haven yen demand expands
USDJPY.invalidation_trigger: US 10Y yield reclaims 5.05% or USDJPY trades above 160.20.

NQ.dominant_mechanism: Tech valuations face liquidity limits -> heavy fund selling -> Nasdaq cascade

Oversold conditions after -13.06% 20D drop could spur short covering
bearish_forces: Headlines confirm US stocks hit liquidity limits with Nasdaq sliding 5%
CFTC Leveraged Funds dumped net -25,357 contracts WoW to net short
NQ.invalidation_trigger: NQ closes back above 26,000 with VIX dropping below 20.0.

SPX.dominant_mechanism: Credit spreads widen and VIX surges -> institutional portfolio hedging -> SPX de-grossing

Leveraged Funds reduced net shorts by +68,082 contracts WoW
bearish_forces: VIX elevated at 26.8 (+40.24% 5D) confirms persistent volatility regime
HYG vs SHY credit stress widening -1.33% 5D pressures equities
SPX.invalidation_trigger: SPX reclaims 7,100 while VIX compresses below 21.0.

Potential Beijing policy stimulus support if local stress deepens

Nikkei -10.00% 5D confirms synchronized regional equity liquidation
HK50.invalidation_trigger: HK50 reclaims 23,000 alongside a confirmed reversal in CSI300.

bearish_forces: Liquidity squeeze deepens crypto rout as BTC breaches $56,000

ETHUSD.dominant_mechanism: Short-term technical bounce fails to overcome dominant multi-week liquidity drain

bearish_forces: Broader crypto market in severe rout with altcoins shedding 10%+
High-beta vulnerability to continued tech and liquidity drain
